name: settings-external-performance
description: The page reports the stored trace switch as off at its start and writes the default log policy, which differs from the policy that the page wrote last; when the host notifies a change of the settings files and the snapshot holds the switch on, the page applies the theme, sends the switch on to the host and then sends the menu language.
reason: The case delivers the workspace-changed notice of the host, and the Go producer runs no window and refuses a notice (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
